messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kevin,

Talesca's specialist work across renewable energy, ESG and sustainability aligns closely with my background in responsible resources leadership. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where transition strategy must connect investment, regulation, communities and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
